name: salinity-shield
description: Salinity Shield AI — Smart Salinity Ingress & Coastal Farmland Protection Advisor. An event-driven multi-agent AI platform powered by IBM Granite on IBM watsonx.ai, providing real-time salinity monitoring, risk assessment, crop advisory, irrigation guidance, land reclamation planning, and multilingual farmer alerts for coastal farmland in Gujarat, India.

PORT.description: Port the Fastify server listens on.

CLIENT_URL.description: Allowed CORS origin for the React frontend.

IBM_PROJECT_ID.description: IBM watsonx.ai project ID. Obtain from https://dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/

IBM_WATSON_API_KEY.description: IBM Cloud API key for IAM authentication to watsonx.ai.

IBM_GRANITE_MODEL_ID.description: IBM Granite model identifier used by all agents.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string for Prisma ORM.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret key for JWT signing (optional, used for user auth).

ibm.fallback_note: When IBM credentials are not configured, agents run in demo mode. Fallback output is clearly labeled [DEMO] in all responses and the UI.

orchestrator.description: Coordinates all specialist agents based on risk level and trend. Selects which agents to activate, manages agent run lifecycle in PostgreSQL, and emits real-time Socket.IO events after each agent step.
orchestrator.trigger: Automatically triggered after each new salinity reading is validated and risk-assessed.

specialist_agents.name: MonitoringAgent
specialist_agents.description: Interprets soil EC, groundwater EC, TDS, and pH readings. Produces a condition summary, key findings, and trend interpretation.

specialist_agents.name: CropAdvisoryAgent
specialist_agents.description: Recommends salinity-tolerant crop alternatives appropriate for Gujarat conditions. Assesses current crop stress risk.

specialist_agents.name: IrrigationAgent
specialist_agents.description: Assesses irrigation water quality and provides guidance on leaching, scheduling, and drainage.

specialist_agents.name: LandReclamationAgent
specialist_agents.description: Plans immediate, short-term, and long-term soil restoration actions to address salinity ingress.

specialist_agents.name: FarmerAlertAgent
specialist_agents.description: Generates plain-language alerts addressed to the farmer. Multilingual: English, Hindi, and Gujarati.

specialist_agents.name: CoastalFarmlandHealthAgent
specialist_agents.description: Runs after all specialist agents complete. Synthesises recent advisories and active alerts into an overall farm health summary.

specialist_agents.name: ChatAdvisor
specialist_agents.description: Handles on-demand conversational queries from the farmer dashboard. Uses IBM Granite chat completions endpoint for contextual, grounded responses.

risk_engine.description: Deterministic, transparent risk calculation. All arithmetic is performed without AI — IBM Granite is not used for risk scoring. Risk levels: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL. Trend detection: IMPROVING | STABLE | WORSENING | RAPIDLY_WORSENING.

multilingual.note: Multilingual output is generated by IBM Granite via the FarmerAlertAgent.

notes: Set all environment variables listed under environment in the IBM Cloud dashboard.
Use IBM Databases for PostgreSQL for the managed DATABASE_URL.
Deploy the client/dist/ static build to IBM Cloud Object Storage or a CDN.
No credentials should be embedded in this file or committed to version control.
IBM API keys and credentials are server-side only — never sent to the browser.
IAM token exchange is performed server-side in server/src/ai/watsonxClient.js.
All .env files are excluded from version control via .gitignore.
Input validation uses Zod schemas on all API endpoints.
